system.description:
A potent alchemical concoction. 

Restores 30 HP and 6 Stn. Removes all harmful status effects.

A basic medicinal brew common amongst soldiers, adventurers and mercenaries. Leaves a bitter aftertaste. 

 Heals 3d6 HP and 3 Stn upon use.

A sacred water meant to fortify the body against witchcraft and sorcery.

Raises the imbiber's Resistance by 5. This bonus diminishes by 1 per turn, until it is ineffectual. Consuming another instance of this item resets its potency.

customData.name: Blessed Water
customData.description: Resistance increased by 1 per stack. Loses one stack at the start of each of this unit’s turns. Drinking another Blessed Water restores it to full potency.

system.description: Common plants with minor alchemical or medicinal properties. Used in basic potions and remedies. Easily found in the wild.
Uncommon plants with potent alchemical effects. Required for advanced potions and powerful remedies. Harder to find and more valuable.
A distilled alcohol, meant for alchemical processes.
